Callout.Name: Gang Fight in Progress
Callout.Message: Two groups fighting, weapons mentioned by the caller.
Callout.Advisory: Six or more, bottles and at least one knife.

Script.Line: He started it. He started it outside the shop.
You are not taking me anywhere. I have not done anything.
My cousin is coming. You want to be gone when he gets here.

Stages.Stage: Second unit is turning into the street.
Two in custody. Ambulance for the one on the ground.

Lines.Approach: Six of them and a knife mentioned. Wait for your second unit - I am not sending you in alone.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
